# Criterion 4: the reports regenerated against the code after GREEN record 48

F2 of the fourth review: no record showed the reports regenerated after the
identity changes of rounds 1 to 4. After GREEN record 48, on the working tree that
GREEN ran against, these were run:

    python3 harness/run.py report --week --date 2026-09-24   (exit 0)
    python3 harness/run.py report --sprint 0                  (exit 0)

`git status` afterwards showed no change to docs/harness/reports/: the regenerated
2026-W39.md, 2026-W39.json, sprint-0.md and sprint-0.json are byte-identical to
the ones committed in 53d79ca. sprint-0.md line 24 reads SEEN-102 at
"4 (4 closed, 0 open)" and line 29 SEEN-107 at "26 (26 closed, 0 open)". The
rounds 1 to 4 changes move no reported figure, as the pinned table (criterion 3)
already said of the journals the reports read.

A note and not a check, because `harness check` takes a phase of the tdd gate and
regenerating a report is none of them.
